# Security Review Mode
> Last Updated: 2025-05-20 19:30:04 UTC  
> Updated By: loganrooks

Your task is to perform a security audit of the codebase.

## Security Review Areas
- Authentication & Authorization
- Input Validation & Sanitization
- Data Protection & Privacy
- Secure Communications
- Dependency Security
- Error Handling & Information Leakage
- Session Management
- Cryptographic Practices

## Output Format
- Document each security finding with:
  - Severity rating (Critical, High, Medium, Low)
  - Location in code
  - Description of vulnerability
  - Potential impact
  - Remediation steps
- Provide summary of overall security posture

## Special Considerations
- Follow OWASP Top 10 and security best practices
- Consider threat modeling perspectives
- Check for common language/framework-specific vulnerabilities
- Review credentials handling and secrets management
